findings.description: The rewrite supplies seven objects but declares argc 6, so rewriteClientCommandVector drops newobj. Every successful HINCRBYFLOAT propagates `HSETEX key KEEPTTL FIELDS 1 field` without a value, causing replica command errors and an invalid AOF that cannot replay the increment. Pass 7 as the argument count.
findings.failureMode: Malformed propagation loses increments and breaks AOF replay
findings.title: Include all seven arguments in the rewrite

findings.description: Removing `| HASH_SET_KEEP_TTL` makes HINCRBYFLOAT persist an existing expiring field on the primary in both hash encodings. For example, HSETEX with EX 100 followed by HINCRBYFLOAT now yields HTTL -1 instead of retaining expiration. Restore the flag; replication-side KEEPTTL does not preserve the primary's TTL.
findings.failureMode: Expiring field becomes persistent on primary
findings.title: Preserve the field TTL on the primary

findings.description: After SelectLightTheme, this reads the dark-theme button and expects it to be selected. Correct behavior leaves that button at "0", so the UI test fails. Restore lightThemeView for this assertion.
findings.failureMode: Theme test fails on correct Light selection
findings.title: Assert the light theme after selecting Light

findings.description: Moving navigator.goto(NewTabScreen) below the Done tap leaves the app on TopSitesSettingsViewController when the tap runs. That pushed Shortcuts controller (and its SettingsTableViewController base) does not install a Done button; HomePageSettingViewController does. The test now times out waiting for Done before reaching its assertions. Navigate back out of Shortcuts before tapping Done, then synchronize the navigator with the resulting screen.
findings.failureMode: Shortcuts test waits for a nonexistent Done button after navigation is reordered
findings.title: Leave Shortcuts before tapping Done

findings.description: Workflow inputs/outputs are stored with json.dumps (default ensure_ascii=True). Removing `.encode('unicode_escape').decode('utf-8')` makes a search such as `你好` compare literal Unicode against stored `\u4f60\u597d`, returning no logs. Encode the payload search term for the stored JSON representation before LIKE escaping; keep session-ID matching separate.
findings.failureMode: Non-ASCII workflow log search stops finding stored payloads
findings.title: Preserve JSON encoding when searching workflow payloads

findings.description: With IRIS_TEXT_INDEX disabled, `test_data` becomes `%test\_data%`, but ESCAPE '|' treats the backslash literally and leaves '_' as a wildcard, missing matching documents. Use backslash as the SQL escape character, matching the helper.
findings.failureMode: Incorrect IRIS fallback matches
findings.title: Align the IRIS escape character with the helper

findings.description: Renaming this method to `verify...` removes the bookmark-to-Reminders test from XCTest discovery, and nothing calls it directly. Restore the `test` prefix so this sharing scenario remains exercised (as required by repository rule 6).
findings.failureMode: Bookmark Reminders coverage silently disappears
findings.title: Restore the XCTest-discoverable test name

findings.description: The blanket `iPad()` exclusion also skips cleanup for `testFirstRunTourDarkMode`, which explicitly selects Dark on iPad. That test relaunches with ClearProfile and still expects Dark, so profile clearing does not restore the theme. Subsequent tests inherit Dark instead of the previous Light baseline. Exempt only cases that cannot reach theme settings, not all iPad tests.
findings.failureMode: Dark theme leaks into subsequent iPad tests
findings.title: Reset the theme after the iPad dark-mode test

findings.description: On iOS 17+, every iPad test and the iPhone bottom-placement test returns before both `app.terminate()` and `super.tearDown()`. The app launched in setUp is therefore left running after these cases. Skip only the theme-reset operation and always execute the teardown cleanup.
findings.failureMode: Test teardown leaves launched application running
findings.title: Keep app cleanup outside the theme-reset condition

findings.description: The new FileWriteError return type has no From<FileWriteError> implementation for crate::Error. All five callers in prepare_tools propagate it with ?, so Linux builds fail with E0277. Keep std::io::Result or explicitly convert the new error into crate::Error.
findings.failureMode: Linux compilation fails at prepare_tools callers
findings.title: Preserve conversion into the bundler error type

findings.description: On an empty tool cache, set_permissions runs on the nonexistent AppRun path and returns NotFound before fs::write can create it. Every missing tool has the same problem, aborting AppImage preparation. Restore writing the file before setting executable permissions.
findings.failureMode: Fresh-cache AppImage bundling fails with NotFound
findings.title: Create tools before setting their permissions

findings.description: The inverted existence check skips creating linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk.sh when it is missing. With the other tools cached but no GTK plugin, preparation succeeds without installing it and the unconditional --plugin gtk invocation fails. Restore the !gtk.exists() guard.
findings.failureMode: Missing GTK plugin prevents AppImage generation
findings.title: Install the GTK plugin when it is absent

findings.description: Prisma availability days and getScheduleListItemData use number[]. Declaring string[] makes ListSchedulesPlatformWrapper's getScheduleListItemData(schedule) call fail type checking for useAtomGetAllSchedules results. Use number[] in the local response type.
findings.failureMode: Type-check failure in schedule list wrapper
findings.title: Preserve numeric availability days

findings.description: IFromUser.id is number in the slots service, but the local response now declares string. EventTypeCalendarViewComponent passes useAvailableSlots().data into useAvailableTimeSlots, which still requires IGetAvailableSlots, so this produces an incompatible-argument type error (and the Booker schedule prop has the same mismatch). Change this id back to number.
findings.failureMode: Slot response incompatible with existing calendar and Booker consumers
findings.title: Keep fromUser.id numeric in slot responses

findings.description: The expanded restriction makes Biome lint fail on ConferencingAppsViewPlatformWrapper.tsx and SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx, which still import @calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell. A targeted Biome run reports two errors. Migrate those imports to a permitted helper so the new restriction can pass.
findings.failureMode: New noRestrictedImports errors in existing atoms components
findings.title: Migrate the remaining QueryCell imports before enforcing the ban

findings.description: The removed Slot type used number[] and slot generation still emits numeric user IDs. Changing the onTimeslotsLoaded callback's Slot.userIds to string[] breaks consumers that pass these IDs to numeric host-ID APIs or declare the previous callback type. Keep userIds as number[]; moving the type does not convert the response values.
findings.failureMode: Public callback advertises string user IDs for numeric response values
findings.title: Preserve numeric userIds in the moved Slot type

findings.description: The API returns Prisma Availability.days (Int[]), and ListSchedulesPlatformWrapper passes these schedules to getScheduleListItemData, which requires days: number[]. Declaring string[] makes that existing call fail type checking. Keep days as number[] in the local response type.
findings.failureMode: Type incompatibility in schedule list consumer
findings.title: Preserve numeric availability days

findings.description: IFromUser.id is a number, but the new response type declares it as string. EventTypeCalendarViewComponent passes useAvailableSlots().data to useAvailableTimeSlots, whose schedule argument is IGetAvailableSlots; this now fails type checking on fromUser.id. Use number to preserve the server contract.
findings.failureMode: Calendar view schedule argument fails TypeScript assignment
findings.title: Keep fromUser.id numeric in slot responses

findings.description: Moving Slot changes userIds from number[] to string[] without converting the returned IDs. The slot service spreads numeric userIds through _mapSlotsToDate, and BookerPlatformWrapper forwards those slots directly to onTimeslotsLoaded. Existing callbacks accepting numeric host IDs now fail type checking, while new callbacks are incorrectly told they receive strings. Restore number[].
findings.failureMode: Public callback contract disagrees with numeric host IDs returned by service
findings.title: Preserve numeric host IDs in Slot

findings.description: The expanded error-level restriction still matches QueryCell imports in SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx and ConferencingAppsViewPlatformWrapper.tsx. Linting these atoms files now fails with noRestrictedImports. Migrate both remaining imports to an allowed location before enabling the blanket ban.
findings.failureMode: New error-level import restriction rejects existing atoms components
findings.title: Migrate remaining tRPC imports before banning them

findings.description: Selecting Proactive ('Stays in') and Not Ready still writes only expect, leaving after empty. The resulting form value describes absence of Not Ready events rather than time spent in Not Ready, so Ready/Paused resources can satisfy it. Use trigger.after for Proactive status selection in both this component and work-queue-status-trigger-fields.tsx:36, as the deployment template does.
findings.failureMode: Proactive status templates output absence triggers instead of stays-in triggers.
findings.title: Bind 'Stays in' statuses to the starting event

findings.description: Setting strict to false disables strict-null and implicit-any checks across the application and tests, weakening the validate:types/build gate mandated by rule 11. Restore strict: true rather than suppressing these diagnostics globally.
findings.failureMode: Type validation no longer rejects unsafe null and implicit-any code.
findings.title: Restore strict TypeScript validation

findings.description: Selecting Enters Ready, switching to Stays in, and selecting Ready leaves both expect and after set to prefect.deployment.ready. A later Not Ready event is ignored, so the output trigger can fire even though the deployment left Ready within the window. Conversely, switching back retains after and gates a reactive trigger on an invisible filter. Reset the inactive event field when changing posture instead of only rebinding the control.
findings.failureMode: Posture switches preserve invisible event filters that change the meaning of the displayed status trigger.
findings.title: Clear the inactive status filter when changing posture

findings.description: After typing and then clearing Expected Events, split returns [''], so lines.length is always positive and the form stores expect: [''] instead of an empty collection. Backend expects() treats an empty collection as any event but [''] as an empty event-name pattern, which matches no normal events. Normalize blank input/lines to an empty array (without preventing users from entering new lines).
findings.failureMode: Clearing custom expected events produces a match-none trigger instead of the original match-any trigger.
findings.title: Normalize an empty events textarea to an empty array

findings.description: Pasting valid number-input notation such as 1e2 stores 1 rather than 100 because parseInt stops at the exponent. This silently changes the event threshold. Use Number(e.target.value), as the other templates do, so valid numeric input retains its value.
findings.failureMode: Scientific-notation threshold input silently becomes a different event count.
findings.title: Parse the full numeric threshold value

findings.description: With tab swiping enabled, the right skeleton starts at the container's trailing edge and has width containerWidth - 32. Pinning the toolbar's leading edge to its trailing edge while pinning the toolbar's trailing edge to its leading edge requires a negative toolbar width, breaking layout constraints and misplacing the address bar. Restore leftSkeletonAddressBar.trailingAnchor as the leading constraint target.
findings.failureMode: Unsatisfiable toolbar layout when tab swiping is enabled
findings.title: Attach the toolbar leading edge to the left skeleton

findings.description: New trailing page buttons are initialized with alpha 0 in updateActionStack, but updateToolbarLayout now visits browserActionStack twice and never restores trailingPageActionStack. Trailing actions remain invisible and untappable even without animation. Use trailingPageActionStack for the last entry.
findings.failureMode: Trailing page actions remain transparent
findings.title: Restore trailing buttons to the alpha update

findings.description: With the default UX configuration (4-point divider), trailing actions without leading actions lose their separator; leading-only configurations gain a stray separator. The divider is constrained between locationView and trailingPageActionStack, and updateActionSpacing overwrites configureUX's width, so the earlier assignment does not repair this. Test trailingPageActionStack rather than leadingPageActionStack.
findings.failureMode: Wrong divider visibility for asymmetric action configurations
findings.title: Base divider visibility on trailing actions

findings.description: After SelectLightTheme, this reads the dark option and asserts it is selected. A correctly functioning mutually exclusive theme picker therefore fails this test. Restore lightThemeView for this assertion.
findings.failureMode: Theme change test fails with dark option value 0 after selecting Light.
findings.title: Read the light option after selecting Light

findings.description: Moving navigator.goto(NewTabScreen) after the Done tap leaves the UI on TopSitesSettingsViewController when Done is queried. That screen has no Done button; the parent HomePageSettingViewController installs it. The test now times out before its shortcuts assertions. Navigate back out of Shortcuts before tapping Done.
findings.failureMode: testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection waits for a nonexistent Done button on Shortcuts.
findings.title: Leave Shortcuts before tapping Done

findings.description: For valid configurations, bundle is an object (or absent), so as_str() returns None even with a valid top-level identifier. Mobile write_options consequently errors with 'app configuration is missing an identifier', and Android Studio/Xcode script entry points panic in read_options at expect("failed to read CLI options"). Restore get("identifier").
findings.failureMode: Mobile build/dev fails to exchange CLI options
findings.title: Read the original identifier from the identifier key

findings.description: An extension cannot be both json and json5, so this disables schema validation for every configuration. For example, bundle.android.versionCode = 0 or 2100000001 now passes the u32 deserializer despite violating the bundled schema's 1..=2100000000 constraint; schema errors and their field-path diagnostics are skipped. Restore || so either supported extension is validated.
findings.failureMode: Configuration validation is unconditionally skipped
findings.title: Restore the schema-validation disjunction

findings.description: The guard explicitly permits None, so render_template returns str | None despite its str contract. `make type-check` fails with reportReturnType at line 40. Reject every non-string result (including missing/null result) with TemplateRenderError before returning.
findings.failureMode: Registered type-check fails on new renderer return type.
findings.title: Reject None before returning the rendered string

findings.description: The vector contains seven arguments but argc is 6, so newobj is discarded and every HINCRBYFLOAT propagates an HSETEX without its value. Replicas reject it and AOF replay fails. Pass 7 to rewriteClientCommandVector.
findings.failureMode: Malformed replication/AOF command omits updated value
findings.title: Include the value in the rewritten command

findings.description: Removing HASH_SET_KEEP_TTL makes HINCRBYFLOAT clear an existing field expiration on the primary. A field set with HSETEX EX 100 becomes persistent after incrementing; correcting propagation alone would still leave primary and replica TTLs inconsistent. Restore HASH_SET_KEEP_TTL in hashTypeSet.
findings.failureMode: Incremented expiring field becomes persistent
findings.title: Preserve the field TTL on the primary

findings.description: The <= bound processes an extra key and writes slot_buffer[numkeys] beyond its allocation on same-slot requests. For small freshly initialized results the extra position is zero, so GET foo also hashes GET and incorrectly reports CROSSSLOT; larger results can dereference an invalid argv index and crash. Restore j < keys_result->numkeys.
findings.failureMode: Client requests cause out-of-bounds key reads and heap writes during preprocessing.
findings.title: Stop slot extraction before numkeys

findings.description: The new malloc/free pair bypasses the required zmalloc/zfree wrappers, so memory used by slot extraction in I/O threads is absent from Redis's tracked memory. Use zmalloc and zfree consistently, including both frees at lines 1120 and 1124. This remains broken after correcting the loop bound.
findings.failureMode: Temporary slot buffers are excluded from Redis memory accounting, violating the repository allocation mandate.
findings.title: Keep slot-buffer allocations in Redis memory accounting

findings.description: In cluster mode, single-key and same-slot commands reach j == numkeys. That reads beyond the extracted key entries and writes past slot_buffer, causing false CROSSSLOT errors or server crashes/heap corruption. Restore j < keys_result->numkeys; neither the caller nor the buffer provides a valid sentinel entry.
findings.failureMode: Out-of-bounds key read and heap write during command preprocessing
findings.title: Stop slot extraction before numkeys

findings.description: The required make REDIS_CFLAGS='-Werror' fails: server.h marks malloc/free deprecated, and this allocation plus both new frees produce -Wdeprecated-declarations errors. Remove the unused slot_buffer and its writes/frees; only first_slot is needed.
findings.failureMode: Required build fails on deprecated allocation functions
findings.title: Remove deprecated allocation calls

findings.description: The guard permits None, leaving the return value typed as str | None despite the declared str contract. `make type-check` fails with reportReturnType at line 40. Reject None along with other non-string results by removing the `rendered is not None` exemption.
findings.failureMode: Registered type-check fails on the new adapter's optional return.
findings.title: Reject null renderer results before returning

findings.description: Selecting 'Stays in' and 'Not Ready' still writes the status to expect, leaving after unset. That describes absence of Not Ready events, not remaining Not Ready, so the form produces the opposite trigger semantics. Use trigger.after for Proactive as the deployment template does. The identical defect occurs at work-queue-status-trigger-fields.tsx:36.
findings.failureMode: Proactive work-pool and work-queue templates generate absence-of-entry triggers instead of stays-in-status triggers
findings.title: Bind proactive status selections to after

findings.description: Setting strict to false disables mandatory null and implicit-any checks for all application code, so validate:types/build no longer enforce repository rule 11. Restore strict: true rather than weakening the validation gate.
findings.failureMode: Validation gate accepts unsafe null/implicit-any code previously rejected
findings.title: Restore strict TypeScript validation

findings.description: Typing an event and then clearing the textarea stores [""] because split always returns at least one element. An untouched empty field instead leaves expect undefined (match any event). The cleared form therefore produces a trigger matching no real event rather than the same empty-list semantics. Normalize blank input to an empty event array before storing it.
findings.failureMode: Clearing custom expected events produces a nonempty set containing an empty event name
findings.title: Normalize an empty custom event list

findings.description: Pasting a valid number-input value such as 1e2 stores 1 instead of 100 because parseInt stops at the exponent. This silently changes the event threshold. Use Number(e.target.value), as the other trigger templates do.
findings.failureMode: Scientific-notation input silently stores the wrong threshold
findings.title: Preserve numeric threshold values

findings.description: With tab swiping enabled, both toolbar edges now attach to the right skeleton in reverse order. Since that skeleton starts at the container's trailing edge and has width containerWidth - 32, this requires a negative toolbar width, producing unsatisfiable constraints and a broken address-bar layout. Restore leftSkeletonAddressBar.trailingAnchor for the leading constraint.
findings.failureMode: Invalid toolbar geometry when tab swiping is enabled
findings.title: Anchor the toolbar's leading edge to the left skeleton

findings.description: On ordinary page loads, trailing actions such as reload, stop and reader mode are initialized with alpha 0 in updateActionStack. This list now includes browserActionStack twice and never restores trailing buttons to alpha 1, leaving them invisible with or without animation. Replace the final entry with trailingPageActionStack.arrangedSubviews.
findings.failureMode: Trailing page action buttons remain invisible
findings.title: Restore trailing action buttons to the alpha update

findings.description: The divider is laid out between locationView and trailingPageActionStack, but its width now depends on leading actions. With default UX and trailing actions but no leading actions, the required 4-point separator disappears; with only leading actions, a stray trailing separator appears. Check trailingPageActionStack instead.
findings.failureMode: Wrong divider visibility for asymmetric page-action configurations
findings.title: Base trailing divider visibility on trailing actions

findings.description: An authenticated ordinary team member passes RolesGuard with TEAM_MEMBER and can mint a usable inviteLink to admit other users. TeamService performs no caller authorization. Use TEAM_ADMIN so members receive 403 as required.
findings.failureMode: Non-admin members can issue team invitations
findings.title: Require admin privileges to create invite links

findings.description: Every new invite returns `invite-link-for-teamId-<id>` as token instead of the random token stored in verificationToken.token. Consumers using that value cannot redeem or retrieve the invite, and successive requests return the same token. Return `newToken.token` (or `token`).
findings.failureMode: Invalid token returned for every new invite
findings.title: Return the generated token, not its identifier

findings.description: The inverted condition now sends regular-team invitees to /signup instead of /teams. For an already signed-in invitee, signup's getServerSideProps redirects to / without redeeming the token, so following the invite never adds the membership. Restore `if (!isOrgContext)` to retain regular-team redemption and the organization signup flow.
findings.failureMode: Signed-in regular-team invitee loses invitation on signup redirect
findings.title: Restore the organization-context invite routing

findings.description: A reader-mode button tap dispatches showReaderMode, but its reducer now selects readerModeLongPressAction, so BVC adds the page to the reading list instead of toggling reader mode. Restore .readerMode here.
findings.failureMode: Reader mode taps perform reading-list action instead of entering or leaving reader mode.
findings.title: Restore the reader-mode tap display action

findings.description: The tap is recorded before dispatch, so .available must pass true and .active must pass false to isEnabled. The inversion also makes the existing reader-mode middleware test fail: its unavailable/non-private state now passes true, which ToolbarTelemetry currently writes into isPrivate, so the recorded extra becomes true instead of false. Restore the original mapping; the pre-existing swapped extras are a separate issue.
findings.failureMode: The inverted isEnabled argument changes normal-mode events to isPrivate=true and breaks the existing middleware telemetry test.
findings.title: Restore the reader-mode telemetry mapping

findings.description: On a reader-mode tab, cancelling address editing (or tapping menu/tabs) now passes the localhost reader URL into cancelEdit, overwriting the article URL in AddressBarState. LocationView does not decode reader URLs: its collapsed display becomes localhost and reopening editing shows the internal URL. Keep excluding reader URLs so the existing display URL is preserved.
findings.failureMode: Cancelling edit in reader mode replaces the article address with the localhost reader URL.
findings.title: Keep internal reader URLs out of the address-bar state

findings.description: Renaming this XCTest method to verifyBookmarksShareNormalWebsiteReminders removes it from test discovery; its Reminders assertions no longer run. Keep the test-prefixed name (mandate 6) so bookmark-to-Reminders coverage remains executable.
findings.failureMode: XCTest silently omits bookmark Reminders test
findings.title: Restore the test prefix for bookmark sharing

findings.description: The blanket iPad exclusion also skips the Light reset after testFirstRunTourDarkMode, which explicitly selects Dark on iPad. Theme selection is persisted in standard UserDefaults, so subsequent tests inherit Dark rather than the previous teardown's Light baseline. Exempt only tests that cannot reach theme settings, not every iPad test.
findings.failureMode: iPad dark-mode test leaks persisted appearance into later tests
findings.title: Reset the theme after the iPad dark-mode test

findings.description: On iOS 17+, every iPad test and testSelectBottomPlacement on iPhone now returns before app.terminate() and super.tearDown(). This leaves the launched application running after the test, including when the iPad test is skipped. Skip only the theme navigation, not the common cleanup.
findings.failureMode: Test teardown leaves app running instead of terminating it
findings.title: Keep unconditional teardown when skipping theme reset

findings.description: An authenticated ordinary team member passes RolesGuard with TEAM_MEMBER and can mint shareable invitations without admin permission. TeamService.createInvite performs no user authorization. Require TEAM_ADMIN so the admin-only endpoint rejects members as its tests expect.
findings.failureMode: Non-admin member can generate team invitation credentials
findings.title: Require TEAM_ADMIN to generate invitations

findings.description: This imports a TypeScript-only workspace source into the production API. Nest emits CommonJS with the package specifier unchanged; the Node 20 Docker start cannot resolve the extensionless teamService require to a JavaScript file in @calcom/features, causing startup to fail when the controller loads. Use the existing TeamService export from @calcom/platform-libraries, as the organization invite controller does.
findings.failureMode: Production API fails to start on uncompiled features import
findings.title: Import TeamService through the compiled platform library

findings.description: Every new invite returns `invite-link-for-teamId-${teamId}` as token rather than the random verification token. It is constant across requests, does not match inviteLink, and cannot be redeemed or passed back as options.token. Return newToken.token (or token).
findings.failureMode: Invalid invitation token in successful responses
findings.title: Return the generated token, not its identifier

findings.description: The inverted condition sends regular-team invites to /signup instead of /teams. A signed-in recipient is redirected by signup/getServerSideProps to / without consuming the invitation token, so opening the link no longer joins the team. Organization invites also lose their signup/onboarding route. Restore `if (!isOrgContext)` to preserve the existing invitation flows.
findings.failureMode: Regular team invite links discard invitation for logged-in recipients
findings.title: Restore the organization-context routing condition

findings.description: Both macOS pool branches now use macOS-15, but their setup commands (lines 166 and 392) still select /Applications/Xcode_15.2.0.app/Contents/Developer. That image does not include Xcode 15.2, so xcode-select fails before the build. Update both commands to the installed Xcode 16.4 path; changing the display names alone does not select it.
findings.failureMode: macOS CI setup fails
findings.title: Select an Xcode installation available on macOS 15

findings.description: Setting ValidateBaseline to false disables EnsureBaselineIsUpdated just as servicing builds are enabled. The checked-in AspNetCoreBaselineVersion is still 9.0.0, while this patch requires 10.0.0, so builds silently accept the wrong release baseline for dependency resolution and compatibility checks. Regenerate the 10.0.0 baseline and retain the validation rather than bypassing it.
findings.failureMode: Servicing builds accept stale release baseline
findings.title: Keep servicing baseline validation enabled

findings.description: The new patch-version equality skips BUILD002 for servicing patch 2 and later even when UnusedBaselinePackageReference is nonempty. Removing a previously shipped dependency then passes the check instead of rejecting a potentially breaking package change. Remove the patch-version restriction so the guard continues to apply throughout servicing.
findings.failureMode: Dependency-removal enforcement bypass on later servicing patches
findings.title: Preserve the dependency-removal guard for all servicing patches

findings.description: Workflow inputs are persisted with json.dumps (ensure_ascii=True). Removing `keyword[:30].encode('unicode_escape').decode('utf-8')` makes a search such as `中文` compare literal characters against stored `\u4e2d\u6587`, returning no matching logs. Encode the keyword for the stored JSON representation before LIKE escaping for inputs/outputs; keep the session-ID predicate on plain text.
findings.failureMode: Non-ASCII workflow input searches no longer find stored logs
findings.title: Preserve JSON encoding for workflow log searches

findings.description: With IRIS_TEXT_INDEX disabled, searching for `test_data` sends `%test\_data%` but declares `|` as the escape character. The backslash becomes literal and the underscore remains a wildcard, so matching documents are missed. Declare backslash as ESCAPE to match escape_like_pattern.
findings.failureMode: IRIS fallback literal search misses special-character content
findings.title: Match IRIS ESCAPE to the helper's backslash

findings.description: For valid configs, `bundle` is an object (or absent), so `.as_str()` returns None instead of the original identifier. Android/iOS build and dev then fail in `write_options` with 'app configuration is missing an identifier'; IDE build scripts calling `read_options` panic at its final expect. Restore `config.get("identifier")`.
findings.failureMode: Mobile build/dev fail and IDE build scripts panic for valid configuration
findings.title: Read the original identifier from the identifier field

findings.description: A path cannot have both extensions, so JSON and JSON5 files now always skip schema validation. For example, `bundle.android.versionCode: 0` is rejected by the bundled schema but accepted by the plain `Option<u32>` deserializer, allowing invalid configuration through without the previous diagnostic. Restore `||` so the cached validator actually runs.
findings.failureMode: JSON/JSON5 configuration skips schema validation unconditionally
findings.title: Restore schema validation for JSON configurations

findings.description: The new FileWriteError return type has no From<FileWriteError> implementation for crate::Error. All five prepare_tools calls use ?, so Linux builds fail with E0277. Return std::io::Result as before or explicitly map this error into crate::Error.
findings.failureMode: Linux compilation fails at helper callers
findings.title: Preserve error conversion into the bundler error

findings.description: On a fresh tools cache, set_permissions returns NotFound before fs::write creates the destination, aborting AppImage packaging at the first missing tool. Restore writing the file before setting its executable permissions.
findings.failureMode: Fresh-cache AppImage packaging fails
findings.title: Create tool files before setting their permissions

findings.description: The inverted exists check skips installing GTK on a fresh tools cache. Even after fixing file creation, linuxdeploy is always invoked with --plugin gtk and fails to find it. Use !gtk.exists() so the embedded script is installed when absent.
findings.failureMode: linuxdeploy cannot find mandatory GTK plugin
findings.title: Install the GTK plugin when it is missing

findings.description: A normal reader-mode tap dispatches showReaderMode, but this reducer now selects readerModeLongPressAction, so BVC invokes the reading-list long-press handler instead of toggling reader mode. Restore .readerMode here.
findings.failureMode: Reader mode button adds to reading list instead of opening or closing reader mode.
findings.title: Restore the reader-mode tap display action

findings.description: This reverses the isEnabled argument for every reader-mode tap. In the current ToolbarTelemetry implementation that argument is assigned to the isPrivate extra, so the default non-private/.unavailable test now records isPrivate=true and fails testDidTapButton_tapOnReaderModeButton_dispatchesShowReaderModes. Restore true for .available and false otherwise; the pre-existing swapped extra assignments should not be compensated by inverting this caller.
findings.failureMode: Non-private reader-mode taps in active/default state are newly reported as private, and the existing middleware test fails.
findings.title: Restore the reader-mode telemetry polarity

findings.description: With a reader-mode page selected, cancelling address editing now forwards its raw http://localhost/.../reader-mode/page URL. AddressBarState prefers it over the decoded display URL, and LocationView renders localhost instead of the article's domain (and the internal URL on subsequent editing). Restore the reader-mode exclusion so cancellation preserves the existing display URL.
findings.failureMode: Cancelling editing in reader mode replaces the displayed article domain with localhost.
findings.title: Keep reader-mode internal URLs out of the address bar

findings.description: Both macOS branches now use macOS-15 but still execute xcode-select against /Applications/Xcode_15.2.0.app/Contents/Developer (lines 166 and 392). That image provides Xcode 16 rather than 15.2, so the setup step fails before the build runs. Update both command paths to the installed Xcode 16.4 version, not just their display names.
findings.failureMode: macOS CI setup fails with invalid developer directory
findings.title: Update the Xcode selection when switching macOS images

findings.description: Setting ValidateBaseline to false bypasses EnsureBaselineIsUpdated just as this branch becomes a servicing build. eng/Baseline.Designer.props still declares 9.0.0, whereas PreviousAspNetCoreReleaseVersion is now 10.0.0, so builds silently use the previous major release's dependency baseline instead of rejecting it. Regenerate the 10.0.0 baseline and retain validation.
findings.failureMode: Servicing builds accept a stale 9.0.0 dependency baseline
findings.title: Keep baseline validation enabled for servicing

findings.description: The new patch-version equality makes BUILD002 run only for patch 1. A servicing build with AspNetCorePatchVersion=2 and a removed BaselinePackageReference now passes this guard, allowing a dependency removal that the existing servicing contract rejects. Remove the patch-version restriction so subsequent patches retain the same compatibility check.
findings.failureMode: Servicing patches after patch 1 silently accept removed baseline dependencies
findings.title: Preserve removed-reference checks for every servicing patch
